instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_palindrome_filter, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/palindrome_filter.dart: List<String> filterPalindromes(List<String> input). Return a new list of input strings that are identical forward and backward, with exact case-sensitive comparison. Retain duplicates and original order. The empty string and single-character strings count as palindromes. Do not mutate input. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
